articles.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
articles.snippet: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

articles.title: Trump Says He Knows 'Nothing' About World Liberty Financial as He Defends UAE Ties
articles.snippet: Pressed on why he doesn't divest from the family's crypto venture, Trump said his sons run the business and every president faces conflicts.
